description: This file defines a class 'SpeechToCompletionBridgeTransformationHandler' with methods for transforming speech request data, converting PCM16 audio data to WAV format, and processing model responses to produce audio content, specifically handling Gemini TTS models.

classes.name: SpeechToCompletionBridgeTransformationHandler
classes.description: Handles transformation of speech-to-text requests and responses, including PCM16 to WAV conversion for Gemini TTS models.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Prepares request parameters for speech-to-text completion, filtering optional params and including voice and response format if provided.

methods.name: _convert_pcm16_to_wav
methods.description: Converts raw PCM16 audio data to WAV format with proper header.

methods.name: _is_gemini_tts_model
methods.description: Checks if the model is a Gemini TTS model that returns PCM16 data.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Processes model response, decodes base64 audio content, converts PCM16 to WAV if necessary, and returns an HTTP response with appropriate headers.
